title: SparkCards: micro-education slabs for first-touch console flows
creator: Maya Chen
description: Introduce a lightweight, composable education component ('SparkCard') that lives in the Console home and per-route dashboards. SparkCards surface exactly one suggested action, short rationale (1–2 lines), and an optional micro-example (snippet/template). The goal is to reduce first-session dropoff and accelerate activation for new teams while keeping the surface unobtrusive for power users.
acceptance_criteria: SparkCard component spec (Figma) with responsive variants for list/grid/layout slots
Copy guidelines for cost literacy and rollout recommendations approved by PM
Prototype tested with 8 participants showing improved task completion in onboarding scenario
Engineering implementation plan and API contract documented (props, analytics hooks, dismissal state)
decisions: Non-modal inline card chosen over modal walkthrough to avoid interrupting long-running operations
Dismissal is per-user and scoped to workspace; dismissed state recorded via analytics event 'sparkcard.dismiss'
Cards will default to 'progressive disclosure' where micro-examples expand in place, not new pages
Cost-related guidance will call out estimated unit impact when we can compute a preflight estimate; otherwise show qualitative guidance
user_research_notes: Unmoderated prototype test (n=8): participants completed ‘create first rollout’ task 28% faster with SparkCards present
Feedback: copy needs clearer call-to-action verb; testers confused by 'Optimize for cost' phrasing—changed to 'Suggested cost-saving setting'
Two participants wanted an 'explain more' link that surfaces a one-paragraph rationale and an example request
Accessibility check: CTA contrast meets AA; will add ARIA label for dismiss control
